title: Harden non-finite body-bone radius handling in morphology bridge
description:
## Summary
Prevent a non-finite authored Body bone radius from bypassing the caller's fallback through `ResolveBodyProxyRadius`.

## User Mandate
> "Review the latest audits and synthesize any further tasks that haven't been captured or otherwise find bugs based on the audits and enrich the task system"

STRICT. Reconcile the Round 23 audit finding with existing task ownership and preserve audit provenance. Do not create a competing radius derivation path.

## Scope
- Harden `MorphologyInfluenceRadiusBridge.ResolveBodyProxyRadius` and its call site so non-finite or non-positive radii cannot enter the proxy-radius calculation.
- Add focused runtime regression coverage for a non-finite radius on a `HasSegment` Body bone, including a case where no body sample falls inside the bone interval.
- Preserve the existing finite-positive fallback and radius-widening behavior for valid inputs.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A `NaN` and positive-infinity authored radius on a segment-bearing Body bone produce a finite deterministic result.
- Empty samples and intervals with no qualifying samples retain the finite fallback rather than returning the raw invalid radius.
- Existing valid Body and limb radius tests remain green.
- Unity runtime tests execute the focused bridge fixture before this task is marked Done.

## Validation
Run the whole solution/project compile gate, focused `MorphologyInfluenceRadiusBridge` runtime tests, existing influence/skinning tests, and `git diff --check`. Source inspection alone is insufficient for Done.

## Findings
Round 23 audit `docs/audits/creaturecreator-round23-radius-nan-bypass-2026-09-10.md` is source-confirmed. The caller sanitizes `spec.Radius`, but `ResolveBodyProxyRadius(spec, ...)` rereads raw `bone.Radius`; `Mathf.Max` does not sanitize NaN. Existing `TSK-0146` covers general bridge branches but lacks this segment-bearing non-finite case, so this task owns the runtime fix plus regression.

## Blockers
Unity execution is required for closure and may be unavailable in the current session.

## Next Step
Implement the smallest finite-positive guard and add the focused regression under the existing bridge test fixture.
